s1_db.content: We need to pick a database for the analytics project. SQLite or PostgreSQL?

Given the concurrent write requirements and the projected dataset size of 50GB, PostgreSQL is the right choice over SQLite. SQLite would bottleneck on writes once you exceed a handful of concurrent producers.

s1_react.content: Can you help me with this React component? It is not re-rendering when the prop changes.
Check whether you are mutating the prop in place. React only re-renders on reference changes; mutating an object will not trigger a re-render.
